title: Grateful Dead Live at Danish Center on 1966-03-12

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of the 3/19/66 Acid Test shows raw early‑Dead energy with standout Pigpen moments, though the tape is a bit muffled and slow‑pitching.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that many listeners find surprisingly clear for a 1966 tap, but several note muffling, pitch issues, and an incomplete picture of the set. Musically the show shines with early‑Dead gems like “You See a Broken Heart,” “Next Time You See Me,” and the playful “Ice Cream Man,” highlighted by Pigpen’s charismatic vocals, while some jams (e.g., before “Death Don't”) feel less cohesive.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical moments and a generally decent soundboard recording offset by noted tape quality problems and mixed reviewer opinions.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as remarkable in places but also muffled, pitched slow, and incomplete; overall decent for a 1966 soundboard tap but with noticeable flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Dead acid‑test vibe with plenty of banter and raw energy; set feels simple and true, though some jams feel out of the groove.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for “fantastic work” alongside Pigpen, showing solid early guitar tone.
